alternatives.proposal: Installed runtime attestation is sufficient execution identity
alternatives.reason: disk/package/current installation may diverge from already-loaded in-memory code and dispatch

alternatives.proposal: One load-time process observation is valid for process lifetime
alternatives.reason: hot reload, monkeypatch, JIT, plugin, lazy import, registry and worker population changes can alter execution after preflight

alternatives.proposal: Rehash disk files immediately before effect
alternatives.reason: current disk bytes do not identify mapped/loaded code, retained bound methods, JIT output or in-memory dispatch

alternatives.proposal: Bind process/load incarnation and revalidate mutation/dispatch/worker identity at use
